news.headline: Rams 'excited' despite late arrival into Melbourne
news.description: Los Angeles Rams head coach Sean McVay and QB Matthew Stafford both feel "well rested" after flying in less than 36 hours before the game, with Stafford saying it was "really well thought out".

news.headline: Drake Maye after 3-INT opener: I lost patience and it cost us
news.description: Drake Maye called his 3-interception performance "unacceptable" in a 13-10 season-opening loss to the Seahawks, noting he "lost patience and it cost us."
